gloss: the garden just outside the house; front yard

definitions.gloss: the garden just outside the house; front yard
definitions.explanation: The part of a garden or yard nearest the house, just outside the rooms or the entrance: where one hangs washing, greets a neighbor, or sees birds.

examples.english: Flowers bloomed just outside the house.

examples.japanese: {庭先|にわさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧。
examples.english: I hang the washing out in the yard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、{庭先|にわさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{小鳥|ことり}→小鳥：01590_kotori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: In the morning I drink coffee watching the little birds that come to the garden.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧ (garden) and ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (front, tip). It names the area right by the house, not the whole garden, and often goes with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {庭先|にわさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play just outside
- {庭先|にわさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to step out into the yard
- {庭先|にわさき}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: selling farm produce from one's own yard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軒先|のきさき}→軒先：08402_nokisaki⟧: under the eaves, the front of the house
- ⟦{玄関先|げんかんさき}→玄関先：31223_genkansaki⟧: at the front door
